skill.displayName: Free Online Video Quality Enhancer – Improve Video Quality with AI – API-powered
skill.summary: Free online video quality enhancer — upscale and enhance video quality using AI

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the free-online-video-quality-enhancer skill.
- Upscale and enhance the quality of videos online using AI.
- Requires a WeShop API key for authentication; supports environment variable detection.
- Provides endpoints to start and monitor enhancement jobs, and to upload images if needed.
- Supports specifying target output resolution (e.g., 2K or 4K).
